import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Read the input matrix
    input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
    df = pd.read_csv(input_path)
    
    # Check if city_id and city_name are already in the dataframe
    if 'city_id' not in df.columns:
        # Assume first column is city_id and second is city_name if not present
        df.columns = ['city_id', 'city_name'] + list(df.columns[1:])
    
    # Get indicator columns (all columns except city_id and city_name)
    indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name']]
    
    # Calculate missingness per indicator
    missing_counts = {}
    total_values = {}
    kept = {}
    
    for col in indicator_cols:
        missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
        total_values = df[col].shape[0]
        missing_rate = missing_count / total_values
        kept[col] = missing_rate <= 0.30
        
        missing_counts[col] = missing_count
        total_values[col] = total_values
        kept[col] = missing_rate <= 0.30
    
    # Create missingness report
    report_data = []
    for col in indicator_cols:
        report_data.append({
            'indicator': col,
            'missing_count': missing_counts[col],
            'missing_rate': round(missing_counts[col] / total_values[col], 6),
            'kept': kept[col]
        })
    
    report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_data)
    report_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv", index=False)
    
    # Create selected matrix with only kept indicators
    kept_indicator_cols = [col for col in indicator_cols if kept[col]]
    selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name']]
    
    for col in kept_indicator_cols:
        selected_df[col] = df[col]
    
    selected_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
